t: 21 Sustainable House Design Ideas · Fontan Architecture
s: September 22, 2024 - The idea is that a compact design is better than a spread-out one. A compact two-story house will tend to be more efficient than a one-story spread-out house. For example, if you want to build a 2,000-square-foot house, making two stories with 1,000 sq ft per story will most likely be more efficient than building one story of 2,000 sq ft. Using local materials in your new sustainable house will reduce the need for shipping. It’s more green to buy locally milled wood than to order it from across the country.
